algorithm_stack.summary: Composite meta-policy: Stage 1 characterizes the workload, Stage 2 picks a surrogate per query cluster, Stage 3 compares selection algorithms (greedy, BO/TPE, hyperband, coordinate descent, ILP, clustered routing), Stage 4 gates architecture components, then the chosen selector deploys pipeline configs.
